XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: The lower cooling air flaps (AKKS) do not close when parking.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles manufactured from 1 July 2018

  • System: Injection

  • Component: Injection control unit

  • Fault: The lower cooling air flaps (AKKS) do not close when the vehicle is parked

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • 138223 (Cooling air flap (AKKS) control active, lower: frozen)

    • 138224 (Active cooling air flap control (AKKS), lower: lower stop position not recognised)

    • 138225 (Active cooling air flap control (AKKS), lower: upper stop position not recognised)

    • 21B042 (Cooling air flap (AKKS) command active, bottom: lockout at all ambient temperatures)

    • 138206 (Active cooling air flap control (AKKS), lower: Locked in the event of high ambient temperature)

    • 138204 (Active cooling air flap control (AKKS), lower: Deviation adjusted for all ambient temperatures)

    • 13822A (Active cooling air flap control (AKKS), bottom: Deviation adjusted at high ambient temperature)
  • Cause: Software error in the injection control unit

• Action: Reprogram the injection control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: CAUTION : If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin
